about: Fortress (Henry, Nov 23): four teams attack each other's bases. Created with Job, a student. Questions come from Quiz Dash's bank (games/race-board/content.json), Battle of Wits sets or a unit; this file only holds the How to play slides.

intro.title: Fortress
text: Four teams defend a base and attack the others.
Answer questions to win bombs, repairs and gold!

rows: lose it and you are out

intro.title: Bombs
text: Right answer: choose a bomb, a repair or gold.

intro.title: Shop and fire
text: After every team has had a turn: the shop opens.
Then fire your bombs at an enemy building!

intro.title: Defend your base
text: Towers stop small bombs and shoot some down.
HQ destroyed? Sacrifice a building to stay in!

intro.title: Power-ups
text: One of each per team, once per game.
Alliance: skip your turn and join forces!

intro.title: Made with Job
text: a student who helped design the game. Thank you, Job!
